pages.title: Copper Coin
pages.text: Copper coins are the money of Gensokyo.$(br2)Characters and shelves both take them — a coin stack is broken into loose coins when there are not enough.$(br2)Coins can also be thrown like danmaku, and a shrine's donation box accepts them and returns a blessing once enough have been given.

$(bold)Trading$()$(br)Talking to a character opens her trades: goods she sells, goods she buys, and work she does.$(br2)The buttons on the right filter by trade type, and the arrows turn the page. Each offer has a stock; once it is used up it cannot be traded until it restocks. The plate on the left shows how much you carry.
$(bold)Shelf Offers$()$(br)Rinnosuke restocks the shelves in Kourindou himself. See $(l:decoration/shelves)Shelves$(/l) for more.
